svg.title: The same agent on every machine
svg.desc: One agent on the OtoDock server, with its instructions, knowledge, workspace, skills and tools, arrives whole on the compute machine, on an admin remote machine and on your own computer, and its files stay in sync. A chat can move from one machine to another and keep working.

g.data-label: The whole agent arrives and stays in sync
An agent can work here by default.
Only your own work runs here.
A chat can move from machine to machine and keep working.
Outbound connection only. No open ports.
